contexts.text: There are so many divisions of intellectual and of voluntary things...
In Heaven, these divisions are called Societies...
Under Divide, see this reference.
That he divided those who were of the Church from the Lord. Signified.
Jehovah... cannot be divided, like the soul of a human father. AC 1999:5.
Multiplication and division, where a like thing is involved, do not vary the thing itself as to what is essential.
To divide the garments (). Explained.
The supreme sense... appears divided in the sense of the letter...
Under Dispose, see this reference.

He shall cut him asunder () = separation and removal from goods and truths; for they who are in Knowledges of good and truth... and are in a life of evil, are said to be cut asunder when they are removed from them...
Hypocrites are thus cut asunder.
Under Disperse, see these references. AC 6361.
The Lord's coat not divided. Explained.
According to the maxim, Divide and rule. TCR 133:end. SE 1793.
To divide the spoil () = to give a possession in the heavenly kingdom.
The ideas of his thought vary, to wit, are multiplied and divided... The former thoughts and affections are also divided, and, when divided, are associated with ideas...
It is not allowable for man to divide his mind...
Until his mind is one, and not divided.
I will divide the spoil () = service.
In (such) the thought and will are divided.
All are there compelled to speak from the heart, and not divide the mind...

They shall divide the silver thereof () = that its truth shall be dissipated... The reason to divide = to dissipate, is that if things which are consociated are divided, they are also dispersed; as he who divides his animus or his mind destroys it... In like manner, he who divides truth from good... In a word, all things which ought to be one, perish if they are divided. This division is meant by (serving two masters)... he who does this, has a divided mind, and thence comes its destruction. Further illustrated. AC 9094.
They who have conscience... have a mind not divided...

To cast lots and divide = to pull asunder and dissipate them... The coat not divided = that Divine spiritual truth proximately proceeding from Divine celestial truth could not be dissipated, because that truth is the internal truth of the Word.
In proportion as dominion enters, their minds are not conjoined, but are divided.
It is not allowable for anyone in Heaven or Hell to have a divided mind... HH 508:7. CL 48. a.[2].
The Divine is one and not divisible. DLW 27.
Lest man should thus have a divided mind...
That the Lord does not suffer anything to be divided. General article.
Peres, or to divide = to disperse. AR 712. AE 373:3.
Everything is divisible to infinity. TCR 33:2.

Every grain of your thought and affection is divisible to infinity; and in proportion as your ideas are divisible, so are you wise. Know, that everything divided is more and more manifold, and not more and more simple; because that which is divided and again divided approaches nearer and nearer to the infinite.

(Heat and light) are divided in proceeding... With men, intelligence... and love are divided, because man is to be reformed... Unless man looks to God... he continually works for their division... In proportion as they are divided, he becomes an image of Lucifer and the dragon...
As the Divine cannot be divided...
That the man who divides the Lord, charity, and faith... is a destroying form.
Each division of man's interiors...
To divide = to dissipate and disperse. References.
To divide (His garments) = to disperse and falsify.
Numbered, weighed, divided = separation from all things of Heaven and the Church.
Under Number, see this reference.
The land shall be divided by a line () = that the Church and all things thereof will be dissipated.
